# Documentation authorship

When generating or substantially rewriting humanities-related or interpretive
texts, including astrology and Human Design practice documents, place an AI
authorship notice at the very top of each document in its language.

State the AI assistant/model identity accurately and include the generation date
in YYYY-MM-DD format. If the underlying model is not identified, explicitly say
so rather than inventing a model name. Keep the notice current when regenerating
the text. Readers must be able to distinguish AI-generated interpretation from
human-authored material.
